card.name: Partway through words ending in -ic/-ica
card.fires_on: The piece just before a final -ic or -ica ending, inside long adjectives such as medica, ophthalmic, neoplastic, episodica, historicas. It appears in Spanish label text and English medical words.

modes.label: Spanish medica
modes.description: The word med in Spanish phrases like indicacion medica or prescripcion medica.

modes.label: English -ic adjectives
modes.description: Middle pieces of medical adjectives like ophthalmic, neoplastic, antimyasthenics.

card.writes: It pushes toward endings like -ica, -ici, -ico and away from -ic and pic.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long medical word that is about to end in -ic or -ica.
